flags.name: download_sync
flags.note: SNOW-749. Gates both halves of the offline-downloads account work: the sign-in requirement on the two start controls (the region roundel and the manage sheet's 'Download a custom area'), and syncing each downloaded area's definition to apps.downloads.DownloadArea. Off is exactly the pre-SNOW-749 behaviour — any visitor can download, and nothing leaves the device.

flags.name: sync_log
flags.note: Gates the SNOW-482 sync-log panel (manage page) and its matching /help/ section — a read-out of the client-side log:sync IndexedDB store of recent real server round-trips.
